paper.title: Algorithm 767: A Fortran 77 package for column reduction of polynomial matrices (COLRED)
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 23(1), Mar 1997, pp. 111-129; collected as TOMS Algorithm 767

claim.text: R(0)(1,1), the (1,1) coefficient of the column reduced polynomial matrix R(s) = P(s) U(s) for COLRED example 2 (DP=3, MP=NP=2, tolerance 1.0D-10), as the shipped reference output (archive member Drivers/Dp/RES) prints it in the 'column reduced polynomial matrix R(s)' section: 151.9532407.

reference.archive: netlib.org/toms/767.gz sha256 240d6fbc7a8a48902aa545c914356479492fbd8840222bbf2a376a5b5953a3f8 (member Drivers/Dp/RES, extracted by the recipe; example 2, R(0) row 1 column 1 = 151.9532407)

attempt: The archive ships Fortran sources and a test driver with its data and shipped output, but no Makefile or build script, so the shipped tree does not build by itself. Build-only workaround: the unedited driver.f, src.f, blas1.f, blas2.f and lapack.f compiled with gfortran -O2 -std=legacy into a binary outside the tree, then run on the archive's own data file (stdin). No source byte is edited (manifests pre == mid == post). Example 2 R(0)(1,1) = 151.9532407, equal to the shipped value at the printed 7 decimals. The complete run (11 examples, 826 lines) matches the shipped RES after normalising the sign of zero: the shipped file prints 0.0000000 where this compiler prints -0.0000000 for some near-zero entries.

original_attempt.reason: The shipped Drivers/Dp directory has no Makefile: 'make: *** No targets specified and no makefile found. Stop.' (make exit 2). There is no authors' build command in the archive to try.

diagnostics.precision: The claim is compared at the printed precision: the shipped RES prints seven decimals and the tolerance 5e-8 is the rounding half-unit of the seventh digit. The produced value printed by the same driver has the same seven decimals; the full-precision value is not printed by the driver and is not computed here.
diagnostics.sign_of_zero: The shipped RES and this compiler's output differ only in the sign printed for zero-valued entries (-0.0000000 versus 0.0000000). After normalising that, the whole output matches line for line. The difference is recorded in evidence/compare-signed-zero-normalised.txt (diff of the normalised files; 0 lines).

build_commands: mkdir -p /work/build && cd /work/build && export PATH=/work/env16/bin:$PATH && T=/work/tree && gfortran -O2 -std=legacy $T/Drivers/Dp/driver.f $T/Src/Dp/src.f $T/Src/Dp/blas1.f $T/Src/Dp/blas2.f $T/Src/Dp/lapack.f -o colred; echo "gfortran exit=$?"
